video.title: FULLTANK SATURDAY: Your Worst Day May Become Your Best Day
video.description:
A sudden loss, a closed career path, or a broken plan might look like a disaster today, but it could be the exact push you need to step into the next chapter of your purpose. Don't judge the whole story while God is still writing the middle pages, because your worst day might just become the setup for your greatest blessing. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #YourWorstDayMayBecomeYourBestDay #TrustTheProcess #BlessingInDisguise #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #GodsPlanIsGreater #Grace

comments.author: @abriellemerckpacaldo9995
comments.text:
Hi bro. Bo, maraming salamat po sa lahat ng mga videos mo.

Gusto ko lang din mag share ng painful experience ko in the past na blessings pala 😊.
Simula nung nagka anak at nagka pamilya ako, wala talaga akong plano mag abroad dahil simpleng buhay lang naman ang gusto ko, may trabaho lang kami mag asawa, may health insurance mga anak ko at buo kaming magkakasama, kontento na ako. Pero di lang yun pala ang gusto ni Lord para sa amin. Kaya binigyan Niya kami ng napakalaki at napakasakit na pagsubok.

Habang nagtatrabaho ang asawa ko nung pandemic, at akoy naging isang full-time housewife nalang after ko isinilang ang pang apat naming anak. Doon na nangyari na nahuli kong nagloko ang asawa ko. 2 yrs ko po tiniis at pinaglaban yun para sa mga anak namin, lalo na wala naman akong trabaho para maka provide sa mga anak ko. pero nung mas lalo kong pinilit, lalo naman akong nasasaktan. To make the story short, nag abroad ako para makapag move on, at the same time para may sarili akong income para sa kinabukasan ng mga anak ko at makatulong sa mga magulang ko. Pero nag provide naman ang ex-husband ko kahit papano para sa mga anak ko, at naging mabuting ama naman siya sa mga anak. Pero iniwan ko na muna mga anak ko sa mga magulang at kapatid ko sa province at nag NZ po ako.

Ang bait talaga ni Lord, di Niya ako pinahirapan sa pagpunta ko dito, tourist entry lang ako pero nakapag apply ako dritsu ng trabaho after a month. At ngayon, mag 3 yrs na ako dito sa NZ, serving the Lord through KPF Filipino Community. Sobra akong napalapit ni Lord dito sa NZ at masasabing kong ito talaga ang plano Niya para sa akin. Masakit man ang process, pero nagtiwala lang ako sa Kanya na ang lahat ng sakit na pinagdaanan ko noon ay lilipas lang at yung sakit ay napapalitan ng sobrang pagmamahal.


Thank you so much for letting me share 😊. Godbless everyone!

comments.author: @HappyworkersPh
comments.text:
Recently, I had to leave a company that I worked for 3 years due to the situation went bad. Aside from the existing "not so good" company culture (gossipping & back fighting was rampant), the company had updated it's computer systems which went bad. Also, my bestfriend in the company, no longer had time for us after she found a partner who happened to be our colleague. In short, I did not see any reason to stay anymore, so I resigned.

The new job that I found is exactly what I'm looking for. Core values such as respect is being promoted and the pay is good.

Now, my bestfriend is reaching out, telling how lucky I am that I am no longer there. Employees are getting frustrated and anxious, she said.

God really knows the best for us. If my bestfriend did not take me for granted, I could have had a reason to stay in that previous company, so God had removed everything from me temporarily so I can move forward. I didn't know that such an amazing plan was placed before me. To God be the glory!🎉🧡
